008package paint.compare;
009
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012import java.util.Map;
013import java.util.Set;
014import java.util.TreeMap;
015import java.util.TreeSet;
016
017/**
018 * Structured outcome of comparing two keyed tables (see {@link TableComparer}).
019 *
020 * <p>Every issue found is recorded as a {@link Difference}: a per-field value
021 * difference on a matched-key row, a row missing from the test side, a row extra
022 * on the test side, or a duplicate key (which means the chosen key is not unique
023 * and the comparison for that key is unreliable).</p>
024 *
025 * <p>The result also tracks how many keyed rows were compared and how many were
026 * identical, so callers can assert a diff budget (typically: zero differences).</p>
027 */
028public final class ComparisonResult {
029
030    /** A single recorded issue. */
031    public static final class Difference {
032        public enum Kind { VALUE, MISSING, EXTRA, DUPLICATE_KEY }
033
034        public final Kind   kind;
035        public final String key;
036        public final String field;     // set only for VALUE
037        public final String baseline;  // set only for VALUE
038        public final String test;      // set only for VALUE
039
040        Difference(Kind kind, String key, String field, String baseline, String test) {
041            this.kind     = kind;
042            this.key      = key;
043            this.field    = field;
044            this.baseline = baseline;
045            this.test     = test;
046        }
047
048        @Override
049        public String toString() {
050            switch (kind) {
051                case MISSING:       return "MISSING       [" + key + "]";
052                case EXTRA:         return "EXTRA         [" + key + "]";
053                case DUPLICATE_KEY: return "DUPLICATE KEY [" + key + "]";
054                default:            return "DIFFER        [" + key + "] " + field
055                                            + ": '" + baseline + "' -> '" + test + "'";
056            }
057        }
058    }
059
060    private final List<Difference> differences = new ArrayList<>();
061    private int comparedRows;   // rows whose key matched on both sides
062    private int identicalRows;  // of those, rows with no field differences
063
064    void addValueDifference(String key, String field, String baseline, String test) {
065        differences.add(new Difference(Difference.Kind.VALUE, key, field, baseline, test));
066    }
067
068    void addMissing(String key)      { differences.add(new Difference(Difference.Kind.MISSING, key, null, null, null)); }
069    void addExtra(String key)        { differences.add(new Difference(Difference.Kind.EXTRA, key, null, null, null)); }
070    void addDuplicateKey(String key) { differences.add(new Difference(Difference.Kind.DUPLICATE_KEY, key, null, null, null)); }
071
072    void incComparedRows()  { comparedRows++; }
073    void incIdenticalRows() { identicalRows++; }
074
075    public List<Difference> differences() { return differences; }
076    public boolean hasDifferences()       { return !differences.isEmpty(); }
077    public int comparedRows()             { return comparedRows; }
078    public int identicalRows()            { return identicalRows; }
079
080    public long count(Difference.Kind kind) {
081        return differences.stream().filter(d -> d.kind == kind).count();
082    }
083
084    /**
085     * Human-readable report grouped by Recording &rarr; Square, mirroring the
086     * legacy {@code CsvComparatorRegression} layout.
087     *
088     * @param splitSquareFromKey when {@code true} (squares, keyed on
089     *        {@code Unique Key}) the row key is split on its last {@code '-'} into
090     *        a recording name and a square number; when {@code false} (recordings,
091     *        keyed on {@code Recording Name}) the whole key is the recording and
092     *        there is no square.
093     */
094    public String reportGrouped(boolean splitSquareFromKey) {
095        // recording -> square -> differences   (sorted the way the old tool sorted them)
096        Map<String, Map<String, List<Difference>>> grouped = new TreeMap<>();
097        int fieldWidth = 2;
098        for (Difference d : differences) {
099            String rec;
100            String sq;
101            int idx = splitSquareFromKey ? d.key.lastIndexOf('-') : -1;
102            if (idx > 0 && idx < d.key.length() - 1) {
103                rec = d.key.substring(0, idx);
104                sq  = d.key.substring(idx + 1);
105            } else {
106                rec = d.key;
107                sq  = "—"; // em dash, for keys without a square suffix (recordings)
108            }
109            grouped.computeIfAbsent(rec, r -> new TreeMap<>())
110                   .computeIfAbsent(sq, s -> new ArrayList<>())
111                   .add(d);
112            if (d.field != null && d.field.length() + 2 > fieldWidth) {
113                fieldWidth = d.field.length() + 2;
114            }
115        }
116
117        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
118        sb.append(String.format(
119                "Compared %d matched-key rows: %d identical, %d differing, %d missing, %d extra, %d duplicate keys.%n",
120                comparedRows, identicalRows, comparedRows - identicalRows,
121                count(Difference.Kind.MISSING), count(Difference.Kind.EXTRA),
122                count(Difference.Kind.DUPLICATE_KEY)));
123        sb.append(System.lineSeparator());
124        sb.append("🔎 Differences grouped by Square").append(System.lineSeparator());
125        sb.append("───────────────────────────────").append(System.lineSeparator());
126
127        int total = 0;
128        Set<String> squaresWithDiffs = new TreeSet<>();
129        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<String, List<Difference>>> recEntry : grouped.entrySet()) {
130            sb.append("Recording: ").append(recEntry.getKey()).append(System.lineSeparator());
131            for (Map.Entry<String, List<Difference>> sqEntry : recEntry.getValue().entrySet()) {
132                String sq = sqEntry.getKey();
133                if (!"—".equals(sq)) {
134                    squaresWithDiffs.add(sq);
135                }
136                sb.append("  ▫ Square ").append(sq).append(":").append(System.lineSeparator());
137                for (Difference d : sqEntry.getValue()) {
138                    if (d.kind == Difference.Kind.VALUE) {
139                        String label = (isNumeric(d.baseline) && isNumeric(d.test))
140                                ? "NUMERIC DIFFERENCE" : "TEXT DIFFERENCE";
141                        sb.append(String.format("     - %-" + fieldWidth + "s: '%s' vs '%s' (%s)%n",
142                                d.field, d.baseline, d.test, label));
143                    } else {
144                        String label;
145                        switch (d.kind) {
146                            case MISSING: label = "Missing in NEW"; break;
147                            case EXTRA:   label = "Extra in NEW";   break;
148                            default:      label = "Duplicate key";  break;
149                        }
150                        sb.append(String.format("     - %-" + fieldWidth + "s: '%s' vs '%s' (%s)%n",
151                                "", "", "", label));
152                    }
153                    total++;
154                }
155            }
156            sb.append(System.lineSeparator());
157        }
158
159        sb.append(String.format("📊 Total differences listed: %d%n", total));
160        if (!squaresWithDiffs.isEmpty()) {
161            StringBuilder join = new StringBuilder();
162            for (String s : squaresWithDiffs) {
163                if (join.length() > 0) {
164                    join.append(", ");
165                }
166                join.append(s);
167            }
168            sb.append(String.format("🟧 Squares with at least one difference: %d (%s)%n",
169                    squaresWithDiffs.size(), join));
170        }
171        return sb.toString();
172    }
173
174    private static boolean isNumeric(String s) {
175        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) {
176            return false;
177        }
178        try {
179            Double.parseDouble(s);
180            return true;
181        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
182            return false;
183        }
184    }
185
186    /** A concise human-readable summary followed by each difference. */
187    public String report() {
188        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
189        sb.append(String.format(
190                "Compared %d matched-key rows: %d identical, %d differing, %d missing, %d extra, %d duplicate keys.%n",
191                comparedRows,
192                identicalRows,
193                comparedRows - identicalRows,
194                count(Difference.Kind.MISSING),
195                count(Difference.Kind.EXTRA),
196                count(Difference.Kind.DUPLICATE_KEY)));
197        for (Difference d : differences) {
198            sb.append("  ").append(d).append(System.lineSeparator());
199        }
200        return sb.toString();
201    }
202}
